capabilities: Record meeting audio from the microphone
Separate and name speakers by voice
Extract summaries, decisions, action items and tickets with an LLM
Import or paste existing meeting transcripts
disambiguation: Not a general note-taking or quick-capture tool; it records meetings and turns them into structured notes.
extras: Desktop only. Audio, transcription and speaker separation run locally; only text is sent to the configured LLM endpoint, and the API key is kept in the system keychain. A macOS setup script installs the speech tools; Linux and Windows are untested. Recording people may require consent.
motivation: Nobody wants to take notes in meetings.
problem: Taking notes during meetings pulls attention away from the conversation, and raw transcripts still have to be turned into decisions, tasks and follow-ups.

relations.evidence: install the BRAT plugin and add stevelohwc/obsidian-take-note

summary: Meeting recorder that transcribes audio locally with Whisper, labels speakers, and uses an LLM to write structured meeting notes.
